latest_release.name: v1.30.2
latest_release.body:
This week's release includes reduced GPU usage across the app, a model picker for AI commit message generation in the Git Panel, a setting to hide the title bar, support for GPT-6.1 Terra, and faster scanning of large projects.

## Features

### AI

- Added support for GPT-6.1 Terra to the OpenAI provider. ([#66659](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66659); thanks [nymo](https://github.com/nymo))
- Added keyboard navigation to the agent thread switcher (opened with `ctrl-tab` from the Agent Panel or Threads Sidebar): `up` / `down`, `ctrl-n` / `ctrl-p`, and `home` / `end` move the selection, as do `ctrl-up` / `ctrl-down` while `ctrl` is still held. ([#66951](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66951); thanks [kinoute](https://github.com/kinoute))
- Added support for the Extra High thinking effort level for Gemini 4 Hydrogen (`gemini-4-hydrogen`), which now defaults to High. ([#67011](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/67011); thanks [LorenzoBiassio](https://github.com/LorenzoBiassio))
- Improved GitHub Copilot models to use their full context window when there is no long-context surcharge, and to display per-token pricing where available. ([#64302](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64302); thanks [Jozef833](https://github.com/Jozef833))
- Improved memory usage when saving long agent threads. ([#66683](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66683); thanks [founderinaction](https://github.com/founderinaction))

### Git

- Added a model picker to the Git Panel's commit editor for choosing the model used for commit message generation. The choice is saved to the `agent.commit_message_model` setting. ([#50674](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50674); thanks [soilSpoon](https://github.com/soilSpoon))

### Vim / Helix

- Added the `g r t` keybinding for `editor: go to type definition`, matching Neovim's default. ([#66759](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66759); thanks [ask4fusora](https://github.com/ask4fusora))
- Added the `] n` and `[ n` keybindings in visual mode for `vim: select next syntax node` and `vim: select previous syntax node`, matching Neovim's defaults. ([#66759](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66759); thanks [ask4fusora](https://github.com/ask4fusora))

### Languages

- Improved syntax highlighting of `#pragma` and `#undef` arguments in C and C++. ([#66875](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66875); thanks [imryanthedev](https://github.com/imryanthedev))

### Linux

- Improved ACP registry agent installation on musl-based Linux systems, such as Alpine, to use musl builds when available. ([#66914](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66914))

### macOS

- Updated the Git version bundled with Zed on macOS to 2.56.1. ([#67264](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/67264))

### Other

- Added a `title_bar.show` setting to hide the title bar always (`"never"`) or only in fullscreen (`"hide_in_full_screen"`). The default is `"always"`. ([#65671](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65671); thanks [wuemeli](https://github.com/wuemeli), and thanks [xipeng-jin](https://github.com/xipeng-jin) for an earlier implementation in [#42540](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/42540))
- Added `editor: fold at current indentation level` to fold the whole document at the current line's indentation level. ([#66849](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66849))
- Added a `zed --debug-state` CLI flag that prints the running app's window, display, and platform state as JSON for debugging. ([#66852](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66852))
- Improved rendering efficiency to reduce GPU usage across the app, including when drawing paths (such as Git Graph lines), shadows, and content hidden behind other elements. ([#66806](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66806), [#66807](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66807), [#66809](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66809), [#668

# Zed

[![Zed](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zed-industries/zed/main/assets/badge/v0.json)](https://zed.dev)
[![CI](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/actions/workflows/run_tests.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/actions/workflows/run_tests.yml)

Welcome to Zed, a high-performance, multiplayer code editor from the creators of [Atom](https://github.com/atom/atom) and [Tree-sitter](https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter).

---

### Installation

On macOS, Linux, and Windows you can [download Zed directly](https://zed.dev/download) or install Zed via your local package manager ([macOS](https://zed.dev/docs/installation#macos)/[Linux](https://zed.dev/docs/linux#installing-via-a-package-manager)/[Windows](https://zed.dev/docs/windows#package-managers)).

Other platforms are not yet available:

- Web ([tracking discussion](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/discussions/26195))

### Developing Zed

- [Building Zed for macOS](./docs/src/development/macos.md)
- [Building Zed for Linux](./docs/src/development/linux.md)
- [Building Zed for Windows](./docs/src/development/windows.md)

### Contributing

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md) for ways you can contribute to Zed.

Also... we're hiring! Check out our [jobs](https://zed.dev/jobs) page for open roles.

### Licensing

Zed source code is licensed primarily under GPL-3.0-or-later, with Apache-2.0 components where marked.

License information for third party dependencies must be correctly provided for CI to pass.

We use [`cargo-about`](https://github.com/EmbarkStudios/cargo-about) to automatically comply with open source licenses. If CI is failing, check the following:

- Is it showing a `no license specified` error for a crate you've created? If so, add `publish = false` under `[package]` in your crate's Cargo.toml.
- Is the error `failed to satisfy license requirements` for a dependency? If so, first determine what license the project has and whether this system is sufficient to comply with this license's requirements. If you're unsure, ask a lawyer. Once you've verified that this system is acceptable add the license's SPDX identifier to the `accepted` array in `script/licenses/zed-licenses.toml`.
- Is `cargo-about` unable to find the license for a dependency? If so, add a clarification field at the end of `script/licenses/zed-licenses.toml`, as specified in the [cargo-about book](https://embarkstudios.github.io/cargo-about/cli/generate/config.html#crate-configuration).

## Sponsorship

Zed is developed by **Zed Industries, Inc.**, a for-profit company.

If you’d like to financially support the project, you can do so via GitHub Sponsors.
Sponsorships go directly to Zed Industries and are used as general company revenue.
There are no perks or entitlements associated with sponsorship.
